fib: ______ is a non-experimental method commonly used in descriptive research in education.
survey method
The survey method is a non-experimental method commonly used in descriptive research in education.
______ refers to whether one variable increases as the other increases (positive), or whether one variable decreases as the other increases (negative).
direction of relationship
The direction of relationship refers to whether one variable increases as the other increases (positive), or whether one variable decreases as the other increases (negative).
______ refers to all the members or items under consideration in a research.
population
A population refers to all the members or items under consideration in a research.
______ are the basis for research, and the first step in the research process is to identify a well-defined problem.
Problems
Problems are the basis for research, and the first step in the research process is to identify a well-defined problem.
______ is used in studies where scores in more than two variables are to be correlated.
Multiple correlation
Multiple correlation is used in studies where scores in more than two variables are to be correlated.
______ is the statistic we most often use to measure the relationship between variables.
correlation coefficient
The correlation coefficient is the statistic we most often use to measure the relationship between variables.
______ is concerned with the study of past events.
Historical research
Historical research is concerned with the study of past events.
______ are used in analysis of variance to describe the degree of relationship between a predictor or set of predictors and the dependent variable.
Effect size measures
Effect size measures are used in analysis of variance to describe the degree of relationship between a predictor or set of predictors and the dependent variable.
______ are used for checking achievement of the objectives stated.
Tests and examinations
Tests and examinations are used for checking achievement of the objectives stated.
______ are used for the controlled testing of causal processes.
Experimental research designs
Experimental research designs are used for the controlled testing of causal processes.
______ is concerned with the degree of relationship between two or more variables.
Correlation
Correlation is concerned with the degree of relationship between two or more variables.
______ is used to test for differences among sample frequency (nominal) data represented as frequency counts or percentages typically presented in a contingency table or cross-tabulation.
Chi-Square

______ means that a test gives dependable or consistent scores.
Reliability
Reliability means that a test gives dependable or consistent scores.
______ is the act or system of methodically arranging a phenomenon in distinct divisions or classes.
Classification
Classification is the act or system of methodically arranging a phenomenon in distinct divisions or classes.
______ is a type of longitudinal design where data are collected over long periods of time, and measurements are taken on each variable over two or more distinct time periods.
Time-series design
Time-series design is a type of longitudinal design where data are collected over long periods of time, and measurements are taken on each variable over two or more distinct time periods.
______ is one of the most important and most common types of research in applied social research like educational research.
Survey research
Survey research is one of the most important and most common types of research in applied social research like educational research.

Measurement
